inherited.policy: Inherited from workspace-ids. Each root includes the rules for the types it uses.

types.name: SessionOperationId
types.rustReader: Requires a lower-case, hyphenated canonical RFC 4122 UUIDv7.
types.schema: String with a lower-case, hyphenated RFC 4122 UUIDv7 pattern.

types.name: SessionId
types.rustReader: Requires 1 to 4096 UTF-8 bytes and refuses NUL.
types.schema: String with 1 to 4096 characters, a pattern that excludes NUL, and x-maxUtf8Bytes set to 4096.

types.name: MachineId
types.schema: String with a lower-case, hyphenated RFC 4122 UUIDv7 pattern.

types.name: SessionRef
types.rustReader: Requires the named pair and applies the inherited identifier readers.
types.schema: Closed object requiring machineId and sessionId with their inherited schema rules.

jsonParserBoundary: Duplicate keys and numeric token spellings inside raw values are handled by the JSON parser.
name: session-read-contract

plainValidatorLimitations.detail: A plain validator ignores x-maxUtf8Bytes. The contract test registers it and the consumer generates a UTF-8 byte-length check.
JSON Schema accepts an integral JSON number such as 1.0. The Rust timestamp reader requires an integer token.
